description: This file defines authentication-related API endpoints for user registration, login, and profile retrieval using FastAPI framework, with database interactions handled via SQLAlchemy asynchronously.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance used to define API endpoints for authentication

methods.name: UserOut register(payload: RegisterRequest, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Handles user registration, creating a new user in the database with hashed password and default role.

methods.name: TokenResponse login(payload: LoginRequest, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns a JWT access token.

methods.name: UserOut me(user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Retrieves the profile information of the currently authenticated user.
